description: Create reviewable dependency-update PRs for Argo CD Application sources.

packageRules.description: Disable Helm values files outside apps/ because manager file patterns are additive to Renovate defaults.
Helm values own image references in values files, preventing duplicate image-update PRs from the Kubernetes manager.
Ceph v20 and later and cephcsi v3.18 and later images require x86-64-v3 (AVX2), but the nodes expose x86-64-v2. Hold them until the node CPU model changes.
Keep cephcsi images below v3.18 (x86-64-v3 required). Chart updates are unaffected because the image tag is pinned in values.
Keep major-version upgrades distinct because they require a compatibility review and explicit rollback assessment.
